name: openspec-ide-monorepo
description: Локальная web-среда для работы по методологии OpenSpec

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/server packages/cli && npm run build -w @openspec-ide/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/server packages/cli && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit && tsc -p packages/desktop
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build -w @openspec-ide/desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist -w @openspec-ide/desktop
scripts.test:desktop: npm run desktop:build && playwright test -c playwright.desktop.config.ts
